meta_description: Ashwood Plumbing & Heating offers expert plumbing and heating services across Nottingham. Gas Safe registered, fast response, free quotes. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Fast Response Across Nottingham
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or heating faults — Ashwood gets to you fast, fixes it right, first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and boiler installations to bathroom fitting and central heating, Ashwood covers every job — large or small.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Supply and fit of A-rated energy-efficient boilers from leading brands. We handle everything from removal of your old unit to full commissioning and Gas Safe certification.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual boiler services to keep your system running safely and efficiently, plus prompt fault diagnosis and repair to restore your heating with minimal disruption.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full central heating installation, upgrades, and power flushing to improve circulation and radiator performance throughout your Nottingham home.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, major leaks, or a sudden loss of hot water — we respond quickly across Nottingham to limit damage and get your home back to normal fast.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom and en-suite fitting, including new showers, baths, basins, and tiling. We manage the entire project from first fix to the final finish.

services.title: Leak Detection & Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Persistent drips, hidden leaks, or damaged pipework can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We locate and resolve the problem cleanly and efficiently.

about_pullquote: Every job done properly — because your home deserves nothing less.
about_para_1: Ashwood Plumbing & Heating has been serving homeowners and landlords across Nottingham for over a decade. Founded on the belief that local tradespeople should be reliable, transparent, and genuinely skilled, we've grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendation. Our engineers are Gas Safe registered and fully qualified to handle everything from a dripping tap to a complete heating system overhaul.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on turning up when we say we will, quoting honestly, and leaving your home clean and tidy after every visit. Our customers return to us year after year because they know they'll get straight-talking advice and quality workmanship — never unnecessary upselling or hidden charges.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Ashwood

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Called Ashwood on a Monday morning with a broken boiler and they were out the same afternoon. Engineer was polite, knowledgeable, and had it sorted within the hour. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Used Ashwood to fit a new bathroom and couldn't be happier with the result. The whole job was completed on time and within budget. Everything was left spotless. Will definitely be using them again for our central heating upgrade.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Had a leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers couldn't track down. Ashwood found it within 20 minutes and had it fixed before lunchtime. Honest pricing and really friendly team. Absolute lifesavers.
reviews.author: Mark H.
